subject: Clarifying the delivery window
text:
Hello.

I need to clarify my last request.

The practical concern is the delivery window.

You mentioned same-day service for the printer.

I did not mean the urgent batch.

Please limit same-day service to the single failed box.

The rest can arrive on Tuesday.

Also, we cannot receive items after four.

Please confirm if this works.

Our dock is busy.
The staff leaves early.
A delay could cause damage.
I want a simple plan.
Please adjust the schedule.
Please reply soon.
I value your flexibility.
Let me know the cost.
That avoids overtime.
It is important.
Please update the invoice too.
The original amount looked high.
I want clarity.
Thank you again.
